newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products boosted by crude,refinery run cut.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products boosted by crude,refinery run cut.

text.p: NWE oil products were up on crude's strength and refinery run cuts on Thursday, traders said.
Gasoline barges were boosted by Texaco Rotterdam's 20 percent run cut, which left prompt supply tight. Eurograde barges traded at $203.50.
Gas oil was slightly firmer with refiners buying focused mainly on cheaper Flushing material with trade at June IPE +50 and +75 cents a tonne for prompt liftings.
High sulphur barges were lifted by bunker demand ahead of the Dutch holiday weekend.
Prices firmed to $85/86 a tonne fob. Cargo markets were quiet.
